Likely a tooling bug: the Sponge x402 payment flow consumes/reuses the request body stream when a body is present, throwing before settlement. A retry with NO body (empty POST) was blocked by the <=2-paid-attempt safety boundary, so the no-body path is unconfirmed.

usage.guide: Call POST https://x402.orth.sh/notte/sessions/start with a JSON body (all fields optional) to start a managed headless browser session via Orthogonal x402; minimal body is {} or {"headless": true}. The response should return a session handle/id you then pass to Notte's scrape/extract and sessions/stop calls. NOTE: this endpoint is UNTESTED — the QA pay tool failed twice with a Sponge 'Body already used' error before any payment settled (no USDC spent), so it must be re-tested once the payment-body tooling issue is resolved (try a no-body empty POST first to isolate). Since sessions accrue duration cost, remember to stop the session when done.
